items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: I got her a job with Eleanor Powell in Eleanor Powell's show when she came to Las Vegas

ctx.x: So that was one of our movements of separation and I helped her do that, I

said "Go ahead." I didn't put no protest against it. I asked you last, do you think she's happy? Do you think she's happy? She done married again following this divorce. But she came back in order to try to entice me to look over the divorce part, but I didn't. I was at Harris at the time. She was stopping across the street from Harris at the Wagon Wheel Hotel, I think that was it. And I'm over at Harris. And she gets to stay there, she wants me to come over to have breakfast. I went over to have breakfast and…

how I felt and everything, I said I'm doing all right. "How are you?" When a friend of mine passed away here in Los Angeles she came to see this friend from Las Vegas, but I got her a job with Eleanor Powell in Eleanor Powell's show when she came to Las Vegas 'cause I took her there on a show I was doing in Las Vegas. I took her from New York to Las Vegas 'cause I wanted to do this show, open the show called the Carver House, colored on the west side of town, a colored club, colored casino 'cause negroes wasn't…
